_comment: Feature-gated Monolith actions: they exist in source but only register in the live catalog when a feature flag is enabled (scene/worldgen registry+debug-view+town-gen are behind bEnableProceduralTownGen; slate widget-inspector and gamefeatures data-inspector behind their own inspector flags). check_skill_catalog_drift.ps1 reports these as GATED (informational), NOT hard drift, so CI can gate on exit-2. Remove a skill's entries (or the whole skill) once its feature is enabled by default, and re-run the audit with the gate ON to verify the documented signatures. Source-confirmed: e.g. scene capture_floor_plan/capture_building_views register in Source/MonolithScene/Private/MonolithMeshDebugViewActions.cpp.
